preconditions.description: The input string `s` contains only digits (0-9).

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for i in range(len(s)+1) if (all(1 <= int(s[j:i]) <= 26 for j in range(i-1, i-2, -1) if j >= 0) and (all(1 <= int(s[k:k+1]) <= 26 for k in range(i-1)) or all(1 <= int(s[k:k+2]) <= 26 for k in range(i-1) if k+1 < len(s)))))
postconditions.description: The return value is the total number of valid ways to decode the string `s` into letters A-Z, where each digit or pair of digits maps to a valid letter (1-26). A valid decoding must cover the entire string without leading zeros in single-digit mappings.
